qsm-tasks doctor.description: Report whether gh, the one program qsm-tasks needs on PATH, is there

qsm-tasks list.description: List every open issue of the current repository with its Status on the board, one per line

qsm-tasks add.description: File an issue from a body file and print its number; with --parent, make it a sub-issue of that issue

args.name: bodyFile
args.description: the file holding the issue body

args.name: parent
args.description: the number of the issue this one becomes a sub-issue of
